purpose: Public-safe family ownership and boundary contract for Foundation plus the private Operations system.

owns: private run records and operational telemetry
must_not_own: public-only contract implementations that belong in foundation
public evidence definitions that are intentionally reusable without protected implementation

historical_repository.name: extractor-mapper
historical_repository.role: Historical source repository for the Operations extractor subsystem. It is not an independent privacy boundary.
historical_repository.retirement_rule: Do not archive until all canonical implementation, tests, workflows, manifests, documentation and references have moved to Operations and the completion gates in operations/docs/REPOSITORY_CONSOLIDATION_PLAN.md are satisfied.

dependency_rule.rule: The arrow describes public contract/result flow, not unrestricted source imports.
dependency_rule.public_to_private_rule: foundation never depends on private repositories or protected implementation.

single_owner_rule: One authoritative implementation owns each behavior. Internal subsystem boundaries do not create additional repository authorities.
change_method: identify the owning subsystem or contract
locate the canonical symbol or contract
run the family overlap audit when ownership or structure changes
remove duplicate implementations after parity evidence
non_negotiable_rules: do not create a second authority for the same policy or resource
do not move protected policy into public foundation
do not make mapping perform network I/O
do not expose credentials, protected topology, or evaluation holdouts through public contracts
do not add new business logic to immutable V175/V18 legacy snapshots
do not archive extractor-mapper before parity evidence and migration gates pass

validation.repository_local: Foundation validates public contracts and primitives; Operations validates its complete private execution/control system.
validation.family_overlap: Operations owns the cross-repository overlap audit because it is the protected family control plane.
validation.deep_audit: The family overlap audit is periodic and exhaustive; local CI remains bounded and deterministic.
